items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Henry said, "Well look, man, you take the job.

ctx.x: Oh, they could play. They had some

band. So anyway, you know how I got that job, actually, with Floyd, he had first picked Henry Allen, the tenor sax@phone player, and Henry said, "Well look, man, you take the job. You know, because I'm going to do something else." So Floyd called me and that's how I really got the job.
I never will forget Henry Allen for that. He was a very fine young man, and a pretty good little sax@phone player.
